propositions: Direct and aliased environment access (load_config, os.getenv, os.environ.get, os.environ subscript, literal getattr) must be rejected below approved composition seams unless explicitly registered with owner and rationale
An AST-based deterministic gate must verify that every declared configuration and credential name has exactly one approved owner seam, with no glob-based exceptions permitted
The ownership gate must be wired into make lint and CI such that both the gate and field-consumption checks are required and cannot be silently omitted from the build workflow

Generated documentation (docs/config.md, docs/security.md) must be byte-current with schema and ownership registries and cover configuration precedence, lifecycle, restart rotation, observability exceptions, and behavior deltas
Legacy facades, migration switches, per-job paths, and ambient reloads must be removed only after focused test suites, behavioral regression oracles, and bounded canaries with redacted evidence pass
